rationale: Build on the current recurrent-tail baseline with a compact structural change instead of another scalar sweep. This adds learned per-tail-block anchor refresh gates inside the reverse recurrence loop so later recurrent passes can gradually retarget the decoder-output anchor toward the evolving recurrent state before applying carry/recur deltas. The change is compile-stable, tiny in bytes, keeps the exact eval/export path intact, and directly tests the still-promising local anchor-refresh idea category.
title: Reverse-Tail Anchor Refresh Gates
